verses.text: Pilate then took Jesus and scourged Him.
verses.textZh: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。

verses.text: And the soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on His head, and put a purple robe on Him;
verses.textZh: 兵丁用荊棘編作冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上紫袍，

verses.text: and they [began] to come up to Him and say, 'Hail, King of the Jews!' and to give Him slaps [in the face].
verses.textZh: 又挨近他，說：恭喜，猶太人的王阿！他們就用手掌打他。

verses.text: Pilate came out again and said to them, 'Behold, I am bringing Him out to you so that you may know that I find no guilt in Him.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多又出來對眾人說：我帶他出來見你們，叫你們知道我查不出他有甚麼罪來。

verses.text: Jesus then came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. [Pilate] said to them, 'Behold, the Man!'
verses.textZh: 耶穌出來，戴著荊棘冠冕，穿著紫袍。彼拉多對他們說：你們看這個人！

verses.text: So when the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they cried out saying, 'Crucify, crucify!' Pilate said to them, 'Take Him yourselves and crucify Him, for I find no guilt in Him.'
verses.textZh: 祭司長和差役看見他，就喊著說：釘他十字架！釘他十字架！彼拉多說：你們自己把他釘十字架罷！我查不出他有甚麼罪來。

verses.text: The Jews answered him, 'We have a law, and by that law He ought to die because He made Himself out [to] [be] the Son of God.'
verses.textZh: 猶太人回答說：我們有律法，按那律法，他是該死的，因他以自己為神的兒子。

verses.text: Therefore when Pilate heard this statement, he was [even] more afraid;
verses.textZh: 彼拉多聽見這話，越發害怕，

verses.text: and he entered into the Praetorium again and said to Jesus, 'Where are You from?' But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textZh: 又進衙門，對耶穌說：你是那裡來的？耶穌卻不回答。

verses.text: So Pilate said to Him, 'You do not speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You, and I have authority to crucify You?'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多說：你不對我說話麼？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架麼？

verses.text: Jesus answered, 'You would have no authority over Me, unless it had been given you from above; for this reason he who delivered Me to you has [the] greater sin.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。

verses.text: As a result of this Pilate made efforts to release Him, but the Jews cried out saying, 'If you release this Man, you are no friend of Caesar; everyone who makes himself out [to be] a king opposes Caesar.'
verses.textZh: 從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊著說：你若釋放這個人，就不是該撒的忠臣（原文作朋友）。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛該撒了。

verses.text: Therefore when Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.textZh: 彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫鋪華石處，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裡坐堂。

verses.text: Now it was the day of preparation for the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jews, 'Behold, your King!'
verses.textZh: 那日是預備逾越節的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：看哪，這是你們的王！

verses.text: So they cried out, 'Away with [Him], away with [Him], crucify Him!' Pilate said to them, 'Shall I crucify your King?' The chief priests answered, 'We have no king but Caesar.'
verses.textZh: 他們喊著說：除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！彼拉多說：我可以把你們的王釘十字架麼？祭司長回答說：除了該撒，我們沒有王。

verses.text: So he then handed Him over to them to be crucified.
verses.textZh: 於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。

verses.text: They took Jesus, therefore, and He went out, bearing His own cross, to the place called the Place of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha.
verses.textZh: 他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背著自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫髑髏地，希伯來話叫各各他。

verses.text: There they crucified Him, and with Him two other men, one on either side, and Jesus in between.
verses.textZh: 他們就在那裡釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘著，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。

verses.text: Pilate also wrote an inscription and put it on the cross. It was written, 'JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多又用牌子寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。

verses.text: Therefore many of the Jews read this inscription, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, Latin [and] in Greek.
verses.textZh: 有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希利尼三樣文字寫的。

verses.text: So the chief priests of the Jews were saying to Pilate, 'Do not write, 'The King of the Jews'; but that He said, 'I am King of the Jews.''
verses.textZh: 猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：不要寫猶太人的王，要寫他自己說：我是猶太人的王。

verses.text: Pilate answered, 'What I have written I have written.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多說：我所寫的，我已經寫上了。

verses.text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His outer garments and made four parts, a part to every soldier and [also] the tunic; now the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece.
verses.textZh: 兵丁既然將耶穌釘在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分為四分，每兵一分；又拿他的裡衣，這件裡衣原來沒有縫兒，是上下一片織成的。

verses.text: So they said to one another, 'Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it, [to decide] whose it shall be'; [this was] to fulfill the Scripture: 'THEY DIVIDED MY OUTER GARMENTS AMONG THEM, AND FOR MY CLOTHING THEY CAST LOTS.'
verses.textZh: 他們就彼此說：我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得著。這要應驗經上的話說：他們分了我的外衣，為我的裡衣拈鬮。兵丁果然做了這事。

verses.text: Therefore the soldiers did these things. But standing by the cross of Jesus were His mother, and His mother's sister, Mary the [wife] of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textZh: 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。

verses.text: When Jesus then saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, 'Woman, behold, your son!'
verses.textZh: 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：母親（原文作婦人），看，你的兒子！

verses.text: Then He said to the disciple, 'Behold, your mother!' From that hour the disciple took her into his own [household].
verses.textZh: 又對那門徒說：看，你的母親！從此，那門徒就接他到自己家裡去了。

verses.text: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things had already been accomplished, to fulfill the Scripture, said, 'I am thirsty.'
verses.textZh: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：我渴了。

verses.text: A jar full of sour wine was standing there; so they put a sponge full of the sour wine upon [a branch] [of] hyssop and brought it up to His mouth.
verses.textZh: 有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裡；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。

verses.text: Therefore when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, 'It is finished!' And He bowed His head and gave up His spirit.
verses.textZh: 耶穌嘗（原文作受）了那醋，就說：成了！便低下頭，將靈魂交付神了。

verses.text: Then the Jews, because it was the day of preparation, so that the bodies would not remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a high day), asked Pilate that their legs might be broken, and [that] they might be taken away.
verses.textZh: 猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。

verses.text: So the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first man and of the other who was crucified with Him;
verses.textZh: 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。

verses.text: but coming to Jesus, when they saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
verses.textZh: 只是來到耶穌那裡，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。

verses.text: But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.textZh: 惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。

verses.text: And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
verses.textZh: 看見這事的那人就作見證─他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的─叫你們也可以信。

verses.text: For these things came to pass to fulfill the Scripture, 'NOT A BONE OF HIM SHALL BE BROKEN.'
verses.textZh: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話說：他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。

verses.text: And again another Scripture says, 'THEY SHALL LOOK ON HIM WHOM THEY PIERCED.'
verses.textZh: 經上又有一句說：他們要仰望自己所扎的人。

verses.text: After these things Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but a secret [one] for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate granted permission. So he came and took away His body.
verses.textZh: 這些事以後，有亞利馬太人約瑟，是耶穌的門徒，只因怕猶太人，就暗暗的作門徒。他來求彼拉多，要把耶穌的身體領去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶穌的身體領去了。

verses.text: Nicodemus, who had first come to Him by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds [weight].
verses.textZh: 又有尼哥底母，就是先前夜裡去見耶穌的，帶著沒藥和沉香約有一百斤前來。

verses.text: So they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen wrappings with the spices, as is the burial custom of the Jews.
verses.textZh: 他們就照猶太人殯葬的規矩，把耶穌的身體用細麻布加上香料裹好了。

verses.text: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
verses.textZh: 在耶穌釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裡有一座新墳墓，是從來沒有葬過人的。

verses.text: Therefore because of the Jewish day of preparation, since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
verses.textZh: 只因是猶太人的預備日，又因那墳墓近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裡。
